items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: He’s bringing this small group over. This will be Pete Christlieb, Bill Perkins, myself, Carl Saunders, Ron Stout, Andy

ctx.x: Vic had a big band in London and now he’s sort of an entrepreneur. He’s bringing this small group over. This will be Pete Christlieb, Bill Perkins, myself, Carl Saunders, Ron Stout, Andy — don’t do this Lanny — the trombone player, a wonderful trombone player — Martin, Andy Martin, a young guy. Have you heard of any of those people?
Some of them. Pete Christlieb for sure.
